name: navigation-menu
useFor: Use for a site's top navigation when a section has several pages worth describing (Tools: site search, grid access, interconnection, fit score). Plain links sit beside the triggers with navigationMenuTriggerStyle.
constraints: A caret that turns or moves on hover
More than two columns of links
Rounded keys or a shadow on the panel
source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the dropdown menu's panel and rows
